name: West Ridge
approach: Via Mosquito Lake Road (from Acme/Welcome) to a bridge over the Middle Fork Nooksack River, then Forest Road 38; park at the gate and continue roughly 5-6 miles with about 2,000-2,500 ft of gain on private-timberland logging roads (commonly covered by mountain bike) to reach the West Ridge climbers' path, which climbs through timber onto the ridge crest.
